key_decisions.decision: Keep the displacement while leaving its broader historical setting unstated.
Preserve Gera’s agency and the subsequent fatherhood notice.
Retain the dismissal of the wives and the Moab setting.
Do not supply Jeiel from chapter 9 where this verse leaves him unnamed.
Preserve all four sons and the Esh-baal name.
Keep Merib-baal rather than replacing the name with Mephibosheth.
Retain Jehoaddah here beside Jarah in chapter 9.
Make the descending sequence clear while preserving Raphah’s form.
